items.summary: A pump moves water, and a pump that moves water can also move current. After reading this article you can name the parts of a pump installation, explain where the leakage comes from, say how current reaches a person through wet ground, compare the six protections that guard the circuit, run a safe check on a pump, and give the right instructions in the first minutes after a shock.
items.title: Water Pumps and the Risk of Electric Leakage
